subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectra-cloud.com>, procurement@vectra-cloud.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist

Hi Alicia / Vectra team —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. This thread will be the central channel for procurement onboarding items so we can get a PO in place and finish vendor setup. To keep things moving, please send the items below as attachments or upload to the Drive link (shared below).

What we need from Vectra to complete onboarding and issue the PO:
- Certificate(s) of insurance (COI) for:
  - Commercial General Liability (CGL): $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate
  - Professional Liability / E&O: $1M
  - Cyber/Network Security: $2M (we require either the policy or an endorsement raising limits to $2M)
- COI should list Redwood Inference, Inc. as a certificate holder and, where applicable, include Additional Insured endorsement for CGL/E&O. Please confirm whether cyber can list Redwood as certificate holder and whether any endorsements are available.
- Completed Redwood Vendor Setup Form (attached in the Drive) or W-9 if applicable.
- Billing contact and invoicing instructions (email + remit address). Do you require a PO number to invoice? Our finance team prefers net-30 unless otherwise agreed.

We'll route any insurance shortfalls to Procurement for an exception decision, but timeline matters. Can you confirm when updated COIs (if needed) will be available?

Links: HubSpot deal / onboarding Drive / vendor setup form (see related_links).

Action items:
1) Alicia: please upload COIs + W-9 and confirm billing email by EOD 3/4.
2) Evelyn (Procurement): I will loop you for review once docs are in.
3) Priyom (Finance): please standby to create PO once procurement signs off.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: none yet (please upload when available).

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectra-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@vectra-cloud.com
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@vectra-cloud.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the note — attaching what we have on file now: Vectra_Insurance_Certificates.pdf (includes CGL and E&O) and our W9 (W9_Vectra.pdf). Quick summary:
- CGL: $1,000,000 / $2,000,000 aggregate (Additional Insured endorsement available for CGL).
- E&O (Professional Liability): $1,000,000.
- Cyber: current primary cyber limit is $1,500,000. We can request an endorsement from our insurer to increase to $2,000,000 and list Redwood as certificate holder; insurer requires ~2 business days to issue endorsement confirmation. Cyber cannot be listed as Additional Insured per current policy wording, but we will request whatever endorsement the carrier can provide.

Billing: we can accept a PO and invoice to billing@vectra-cloud.com. Our standard terms are net-30; happy to confirm if needed.

Estimated timeline: updated cyber endorsement and final COI by EOD 3/06/2026.

I’ll upload the files to the Drive folder and reply here once the endorsement is uploaded.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Lead, Vectra Cloud
alicia.gomez@vectra-cloud.com
Attachments: Vectra_Insurance_Certificates.pdf (PDF, 3 pages), W9_Vectra.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist

Evelyn / Priyom — forwarding Vectra's current docs. See vendor note below: cyber is at $1.5M today; they will request endorsement to reach $2M by 3/06.

Evelyn: can you confirm whether an endorsement to list Redwood as certificate holder (and confirmation of policy period/retro date) will satisfy procurement? If not, what is the quickest path to approval?

Priyom: if procurement confirms acceptance, can you prepare a PO referencing deal HB-2026-7249 and billing@vectra-cloud.com as remit? Estimated invoice start month will be April.

Quick links: HubSpot / Drive / Redwood setup form.

Thanks —
Ben

(see attached)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick upload, Alicia. I reviewed the attached COIs. A couple items we need clarified/confirmed before I can approve:

1) Cyber limits: Vectra's current cyber primary limit is $1.5M which is below our standard requirement of $2M. We will accept an insurer endorsement or an updated policy showing $2M. Please confirm insurer name, policy period (start/end), and any retroactive date.

2) Ransomware / sublimits: please confirm whether the cyber policy includes coverage for ransomware and whether there are any sublimits that would materially reduce coverage for incident response and notification costs. If there are sublimits, provide amounts and explanation.

3) Additional insured / waiver of subrogation: CGL and E&O endorsements are acceptable as listed; cyber endorsements normally do not provide Additional Insured wording, which is fine if the carrier will at least list Redwood as certificate holder and confirm the absence of restrictive endorsements.

Decision rubric: if Vectra provides the cyber endorsement (raising to $2M) and confirms ransomware coverages by EOD 3/06, Procurement will approve and I will sign off for PO issuance. If not received by EOD 3/06, we will escalate to Legal for formal exception.

Please upload the requested items to the Drive and notify here.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Setup_Form.pdf (please complete bank/billing details there if you prefer).

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vectra-cloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@vectra-cloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: insurance certificates, PO setup, and procurement checklist

Evelyn / Ben —

Thanks for the guidance. Per discussion with our broker:
- We have requested the endorsement to raise cyber to $2M and to list Redwood Inference as a certificate holder. The broker expects to issue the endorsement and updated COI by EOD 3/06.
- Cyber policy includes ransomware coverage; there is no separate sublimit for ransomware beyond the policy aggregate. I will confirm the exact policy period and retroactive date when the updated COI posts.

Billing contact confirmation: please invoice to finance@vectra-cloud.com (billing@vectra-cloud.com is a general mailbox; finance@vectra-cloud.com is preferred). We accept PO references and will invoice net-30.

I will upload the endorsement/updated COI to the Drive and post here once available.

Best regards,
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Lead, Vectra Cloud
alicia.gomez@vectra-cloud.com
Attachments: updated_coi_pending.pdf (placeholder — final COI will be uploaded once issued).
